fields.narrative_intro: *An overstimulated person and a droopy person discuss Nvidia AVO's perfect ARC-AGI-3 score inside a password reset email loop that has been going for three days.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
OVERSTIMULATED PERSON: "Nvidia AVO just scored 100% on ARC-AGI-3."
DROOPY PERSON: "Claude Opus 5 alone scores 30%."
fields.panel2:
[build]
OVERSTIMULATED PERSON: "Same model. They just added memory, feedback loops, supervision."
DROOPY PERSON: "So... scaffolding did it."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
OVERSTIMULATED PERSON: "'The model is not the entire agent.' That's their headline thesis."
DROOPY PERSON: "We've been clicking 'reset password' for 72 hours."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: Both characters stare at a mountain of identical 'Your password reset link has expired' emails piling to the ceiling. The overstimulated person's eye twitches. The droopy person holds another unopened email.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
DROOPY PERSON: "We also have persistent memory, supervision, and feedback loops."
OVERSTIMULATED PERSON: "We scored zero on 183 levels."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: A sticky note on the wall reads 'AVO: 6,624 actions. Us: 6,624 clicks. Efficiency: 0%.' A new password reset email arrives with an audible ding.]

narrative_summary: Two characters trapped in a password reset loop realize they technically have all the same architectural ingredients as Nvidia's AVO — persistent memory, feedback loops, supervision — yet remain completely non-functional, inverting Nvidia's 'scaffolding is everything' thesis to devastating effect.
rationale: Candidate 1 earns its punchline through the sticky-note button — '6,624 actions. 6,624 clicks. Efficiency: 0%' — which is a genuinely specific, earned inversion of Nvidia's own benchmark numbers rather than a restatement of the setup. The silent panel 4 does real visual work, and the deadpan voice keeps the joke from over-explaining what Candidates 2 and 5 both fumble by spelling out the irony too loudly.
story_title: Nvidia AVO scores 100% on the ARC-AGI-3 interactive reasoning benchmark
place: inside a password reset email loop that has been going for three days
hat_pair: bucket hat with googly eyes all over it
giant foam USB drive worn as a hat with the metal connector as the brim
